title: Universe screen continuation authorization (v0.1, prefix reuse + bounded count retry)
description: Per-run authorization for the ADR-118 continuation route. It binds everything a v0.3 live grant binds - the V5 prompt bytes, the packet cohort, the selection, the enablement, the client contract, the route, the endpoints and the budgets - and adds the two things a continuation needs. First, the source binding: one explicitly named failed run, pinned by its receipt digest, its raw-response archive digest, its run id and the digest of the authorization it ran under. There is no discovery here; a continuation that cannot name its parent by hash does not run. Second, the split accounting: logical_row_cap covers the whole cohort, reused_prefix_row_cap covers the rows revalidated from the parent, model_called_row_cap covers the rows this run will actually send, and the three send ceilings are derived from the model-called rows alone - three countTokens attempts, five generateContent attempts, eight external requests each. The per-row multipliers are consts; the row counts never are, because they are re-derived from the parent archive and the current selection at preflight and refused on any drift. max_model_evidence_unverified is a real circuit breaker over the whole cohort, reused rows included: a continuation inherits its parent's unverified rows and must be authorized to carry them. Runtime-only: never committed to source control.

source_run_id.description: The failed run whose completed prefix is reused. Named, never discovered.

source_receipt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the parent failure receipt bytes. The parent must hold a receipt: a manifest-bearing run is complete and is not a continuation source.

source_raw_responses_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the parent raw-response archive, the only row-level evidence a failed run leaves. Re-hashed at preflight and carried into the new archive as a byte-identical prefix.

source_authorization_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the grant the parent ran under. Must equal the receipt's own authorization_sha256, and its packet, selection, prompt, route and contract bindings must equal this grant's, or the prefix was produced under different rules and is not reusable.

logical_row_cap.description: Every valid packet row of the cohort. Equals reused_prefix_row_cap plus model_called_row_cap, checked at preflight.

reused_prefix_row_cap.description: Rows revalidated from the parent archive. No model call is made for any of them.

model_called_row_cap.description: The suffix this run actually sends. Every send ceiling below derives from this number alone.

provider_attempt_cap.description: model_called_row_cap times the unchanged five-attempt generate ceiling.

budget_max_external_requests.description: model_called_row_cap times eight: three countTokens attempts plus five generateContent attempts per row.

screen_count_retry_policy_version.description: Pinned by const so a grant minted for the un-retried countTokens route cannot be executed here.

max_model_evidence_unverified.description: The whole-cohort breaker, reused rows included. Sized to measured reality by the authorizing operator; it is a stopping threshold, never a quality target.
